    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [

    ],

  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      415,
      531,
      425
    ],
    "text": "t\u00fcrl\u00fc g\u0131da ve ihtiya\u00e7 maddelerini toptan ve perakende olarak yurt i\u00e7inden ve"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      425,
      530,
      435
    ],
    "text": "yurtd\u0131\u015f\u0131ndan almak, satmak, ithal ve ihra\u00e7 etmek 5- Her Nevi G\u0131da Maddeleri \u00eele \u0130lgili"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      435,
      530,
      445
    ],
    "text": "Olarak Hayvani \u00dcr\u00fcnlerden Sucuk, Sosis, Salam, Past\u0131rma, Kavurma, Beyaz Peynir,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      444,
      531,
      455
    ],
    "text": "Tulum Peyniri, Ka\u015far Peyniri, Dil Peyniri, Gibi Emtialar \u00eele Bakliyatlardan Nohut, Kuru"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      454,
      530,
      464
    ],
    "text": "Fasulye, Mercimek, Bakla, Pirin\u00e7, Gibi Emtialar\u0131n Patates, So\u011fan, Sar\u0131msaklar\u0131n,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      464,
      530,
      474
    ],
    "text": "Kuruyemi\u015f \u00c7e\u015fitlerinden Kabuklu Ve Kabuksuz \u00ee\u00e7 F\u0131nd\u0131klar, F\u0131st\u0131klar, Bademler, \u00c7am"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      474,
      531,
      484
    ],
    "text": "F\u0131st\u0131\u011f\u0131, Amerikan F\u0131st\u0131\u011f\u0131, Antep F\u0131st\u0131\u011f\u0131, \u00ee\u00e7 Ve Kabuklu Cevizler, Kabak \u00c7ekirde\u011fi, Ay"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      483,
      530,
      494
    ],
    "text": "\u00c7ekirde\u011fi, Tuzlu Ve Tuzsuz Leblebiler, \u00ee\u011fde, H\u00fcnnap, Ke\u00e7i Boynuzu, Kurutulmu\u015f"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      493,
      530,
      503
    ],
    "text": "Meyveler, \u0130nciler, \u00dcz\u00fcmler, Kay\u0131s\u0131lar, Erikler, Dut, Sak\u0131z Leblebisi, \u015eekerli Unlu, Kakaolu,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      503,
      531,
      513
    ],
    "text": "Mamuller \u00eele Kuru Ve Ya\u015f Sebzeler, Meyvelerin Al\u0131m\u0131, Sat\u0131m\u0131, imalat\u0131, \u0130thalat Ve"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      513,
      531,
      523
    ],
    "text": "\u0130hracat\u0131n\u0131n Yap\u0131lmas\u0131. 6- Her Cins Ya\u015f Ve Kuru sebze ve Meyvelerin al\u0131m\u0131 sat\u0131m\u0131 ile"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      523,
      531,
      533
    ],
    "text": "bunlar\u0131n m\u00fcstahsillerden al\u0131nmas\u0131, kurutulmas\u0131, konserve, marmelat ve re\u00e7ellerinin"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      532,
      531,
      542
    ],
    "text": "yap\u0131lmas\u0131 yapt\u0131r\u0131lmas\u0131, ithalat\u0131 ve ihracat\u0131n\u0131n yap\u0131lmas\u0131 7- Her Nevi Baharatlar\u0131n"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      542,
      530,
      552
    ],
    "text": "(Safran, Karabiber, Kekik, Kimyon, Zence\ufb01l, K\u0131rm\u0131z\u0131 Biber Vs.), Aktariye \u00eele \u0130lgili"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      552,
      530,
      562
    ],
    "text": "Emtialar\u0131n \u015eekercilik Ve Pastac\u0131l\u0131kta Kullan\u0131lan Malzemelerin, Pastane Ve Unlu G\u0131da"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      562,
      530,
      572
    ],
    "text": "Mamullerinin \u00dcretimini Yapan Kurulu\u015flar\u0131n Her Nevi Emtialar\u0131n\u0131n Al\u0131m\u0131, Sat\u0131m\u0131 ile Tabii"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      571,
      530,
      581
    ],
    "text": "\u00c7i\u00e7ek Ve Otlardan Elde. Edilen Koku Ve Esanslar\u0131 G\u00fcl Ya\u011f\u0131 Gibi Emtialar\u0131n Al\u0131m\u0131 Sat\u0131m\u0131,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      581,
      530,
      591
    ],
    "text": "\u0130thalat\u0131 Ve ihracat\u0131n\u0131n Yap\u0131lmas\u0131. Ya\u015f Meyve Sebze \u00eele Her T\u00fcrl\u00fc Bakliyat\u0131n Toptan Veya"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      591,
      531,
      601
    ],
    "text": "Bah\u00e7e Sera Ve Tarlalardan Al\u0131m\u0131 \u00eele Toptan Sat\u0131\u015f\u0131 Ve \u0130hracat\u0131n\u0131 Yapmak. 8- Her nevi ve"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      601,
      531,
      611
    ],
    "text": "t\u00fcrde; s\u0131v\u0131, kuru, ya\u015f, dondurulmu\u015f, g\u0131da, konserve, cips, s\u0131cak, so\u011fuk ve ya\u011f halinde"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      610,
      531,
      620
    ],
    "text": "g\u0131da maddelerinin al\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 ve sat\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 yapmak, bayili\u011fini almak toptan ve perakende"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      620,
      531,
      630
    ],
    "text": "ticareti ile da\u011f\u0131t\u0131m ve pazarlamas\u0131n\u0131 yapmak. 9- G\u0131da sanayi ile ilgili olarak her nevi \u00e7ay"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      630,
      531,
      640
    ],
    "text": "ve \u00e7ay mamulleri, meyve \u00e7aylar\u0131, t\u00fct\u00fcn, t\u00fct\u00fcn mamulleri, tah\u0131l \u00fcr\u00fcnleri \u015feker ve \u015feker"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      640,
      531,
      650
    ],
    "text": "mamulleri, kakao ve muhtahzarlar\u0131n\u0131, sanayi yoluyla dondurulmu\u015f, kurutulmu\u015f, su"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      649,
      531,
      659
    ],
    "text": "haline getirilmi\u015f veya \u00f6\u011f\u00fct\u00fclm\u00fc\u015f \u00e7e\u015fitli meyve ve sebzeleri, nebati ya\u011flar\u0131, et, bal\u0131k ve"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      659,
      531,
      669
    ],
    "text": "kabuklu hayvanlar\u0131, un, ni\u015fasta ve pastac\u0131l\u0131k mamullerini, me\u015frubat, alkols\u00fcz i\u00e7ki ve"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      669,
      530,
      679
    ],
    "text": "sirkeleri; s\u00fct ve s\u00fctten mamul g\u0131da, organik g\u0131da \u00fcr\u00fcnlerinin \u00fcretimi ile toptan veya"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      679,
      530,
      689
    ],
    "text": "perakende sat\u0131\u015f\u0131n\u0131 yapmak. Bilimum g\u0131da maddelerini ithal etmek, \u00fcretti\u011fi veya ithal"

  {

    "bbox": [
      172,

    ],
    "text": "etti\u011fi g\u0131da maddelerinin toptan ve perakende yurt i\u00e7i ve d\u0131\u015f\u0131nda da\u011f\u0131t\u0131m ve"

  {

    ],
    "text": "pazarlamas\u0131n\u0131 yapmakt\u0131r. 10- Her t\u00fcrl\u00fc meyve ve sular\u0131, kolal\u0131 i\u00e7eceklerin al\u0131m sat\u0131m\u0131,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      708,
      531,
      718
    ],
    "text": "ithalat\u0131n\u0131 ve ihracat\u0131n\u0131 yapmak. 11- Her t\u00fcrl\u00fc g\u0131da ve ihtiya\u00e7 maddelerini toptan ve"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      718,
      530,
      728
    ],
    "text": "perakende olarak yurt i\u00e7inden ve yurtd\u0131\u015f\u0131ndan almak, satmak, ithal ve ihra\u00e7 etmek. 12-"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      727,
      530,
      737
    ],
    "text": "Her nevi tekel maddelerinin bayili\u011fini almak, toptan ve perakende pazarlamas\u0131n\u0131"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      737,
      531,
      747
    ],
    "text": "yapmak her t\u00fcrl\u00fc bakkaliye ve market \u00fcr\u00fcnlerinin da\u011f\u0131t\u0131m\u0131 ve sat\u0131\u015f\u0131n\u0131 yapmak. 13- Her"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      747,
      530,
      757
    ],
    "text": "t\u00fcrl\u00fc i\u00e7ecek ve yiyecek, temizlik maddelerinin al\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 ve sat\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 yapmak, bayili\u011fini"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      757,

      767
    ],
    "text": "almak, pazarlamak, da\u011f\u0131t\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 yapmak ithal ve ihra\u00e7 etmek. 14- Her t\u00fcrden ve t\u00fcrl\u00fc"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      767,
      530,
      777
    ],
    "text": "g\u0131da ve g\u0131da ihtiya\u00e7 maddeleri ile su, s\u00fct ve s\u00fct mamulleri, maden suyu, gazl\u0131 i\u00e7ecek,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [

    "text": "kozmetik ve temizlik, maddelerinin al\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 sat\u0131m\u0131n\u0131, imalat\u0131n\u0131 yapmak, ithalat ve"

    ],

    "bbox": [
      172,
      357,
      530,
      367
    ],

      172,
      376,

    ],

    ],

    ],
    "text": "t\u00fcrl\u00fc g\u0131da ve ihtiya\u00e7 maddelerini toptan ve perakende olarak yurt i\u00e7inden ve"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      425,
      530,

    ],
    "text": "yurtd\u0131\u015f\u0131ndan almak, satmak, ithal ve ihra\u00e7 etmek 5- Her Nevi G\u0131da Maddeleri \u00eele \u0130lgili"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      435,
      530,
      445
    ],
    "text": "Olarak Hayvani \u00dcr\u00fcnlerden Sucuk, Sosis, Salam, Past\u0131rma, Kavurma, Beyaz Peynir,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      444,

      455
    ],
    "text": "Tulum Peyniri, Ka\u015far Peyniri, Dil Peyniri, Gibi Emtialar \u00eele Bakliyatlardan Nohut, Kuru"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      454,
      530,
      464
    ],
    "text": "Fasulye, Mercimek, Bakla, Pirin\u00e7, Gibi Emtialar\u0131n Patates, So\u011fan, Sar\u0131msaklar\u0131n,"

    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      464,
      530,
      474
    ],
    "text": "Kuruyemi\u015f \u00c7e\u015fitlerinden Kabuklu Ve Kabuksuz \u00ee\u00e7 F\u0131nd\u0131klar, F\u0131st\u0131klar, Bademler, \u00c7am"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      474,
      531,
      484
    ],

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      483,
      530,
      494
    ],
    "text": "\u00c7ekirde\u011fi, Tuzlu Ve Tuzsuz Leblebiler, \u00ee\u011fde, H\u00fcnnap, Ke\u00e7i Boynuzu, Kurutulmu\u015f"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      493,
      530,
      503
    ],
    "text": "Meyveler, \u0130nciler, \u00dcz\u00fcmler, Kay\u0131s\u0131lar, Erikler, Dut, Sak\u0131z Leblebisi, \u015eekerli Unlu, Kakaolu,"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      503,
      531,
      513
    ],
    "text": "Mamuller \u00eele Kuru Ve Ya\u015f Sebzeler, Meyvelerin Al\u0131m\u0131, Sat\u0131m\u0131, imalat\u0131, \u0130thalat Ve"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      513,
      531,
      523
    ],
    "text": "\u0130hracat\u0131n\u0131n Yap\u0131lmas\u0131. 6- Her Cins Ya\u015f Ve Kuru sebze ve Meyvelerin al\u0131m\u0131 sat\u0131m\u0131 ile"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      523,
      531,
      533
    ],

    "type": "text",

      542,
      530,
      552
    ],

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      552,
      530,
      562
    ],
    "text": "Emtialar\u0131n \u015eekercilik Ve Pastac\u0131l\u0131kta Kullan\u0131lan Malzemelerin, Pastane Ve Unlu G\u0131da"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      562,
      530,
      572
    ],
    "text": "Mamullerinin \u00dcretimini Yapan Kurulu\u015flar\u0131n Her Nevi Emtialar\u0131n\u0131n Al\u0131m\u0131, Sat\u0131m\u0131 ile Tabii"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      571,
      530,
      581
    ],
    "text": "\u00c7i\u00e7ek Ve Otlardan Elde. Edilen Koku Ve Esanslar\u0131 G\u00fcl Ya\u011f\u0131 Gibi Emtialar\u0131n Al\u0131m\u0131 Sat\u0131m\u0131,"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      581,
      530,
      591
    ],
    "text": "\u0130thalat\u0131 Ve ihracat\u0131n\u0131n Yap\u0131lmas\u0131. Ya\u015f Meyve Sebze \u00eele Her T\u00fcrl\u00fc Bakliyat\u0131n Toptan Veya"

  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      172,
      591,
      531,
      601
    ],
    "text": "Bah\u00e7e Sera Ve Tarlalardan Al\u0131m\u0131 \u00eele Toptan Sat\u0131\u015f\u0131 Ve \u0130hracat\u0131n\u0131 Yapmak. 8- Her nevi ve"

    "bbox": [
      172,

      531,
      611
    ],
    "text": "t\u00fcrde; s\u0131v\u0131, kuru, ya\u015f, dondurulmu\u015f, g\u0131da, konserve, cips, s\u0131cak, so\u011fuk ve ya\u011f halinde"

    "text": "g\u0131da maddelerinin al\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 ve sat\u0131m\u0131n\u0131 yapmak, bayili\u011fini almak toptan ve perakende"

<system>Use this JSON layout to verify observations:
[
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      0,
      0,
      596,
      13
    ],
    "text": "ControlNet: Controlling Di\ufb00usion Model Outputs https://blog.godesteem.de/notes/controlnet/"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      51,
      498,
      84
    ],
    "text": "ControlNet: Controlling Di\ufb00usion"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      42,
      52,
      69,
      68
    ],
    "text": "Back"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      84,
      272,
      117
    ],
    "text": "Model Outputs"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      133,
      502,
      149
    ],
    "text": "G'day! Today I'll describe my short intermezzo with the  ControlNet  (L."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      149,
      502,
      166
    ],
    "text": "Zhang et. al) architecture. Originally, I announced this in my previous"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      166,
      502,
      182
    ],
    "text": "post about the  IP-Adapter , where I mentioned that I wanted to have"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      182,
      360,
      199
    ],
    "text": "more control over the di\ufb00usion model outputs."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      211,
      502,
      227
    ],
    "text": "But I didn't want to just use this announced silver bullet. I wanted to go"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      227,
      502,
      244
    ],
    "text": "a step beyond that and wanted to use the most optimized version of the"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      244,
      231,
      260
    ],
    "text": "ControlNet architecture."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      275,
      246,
      299
    ],
    "text": "Di\ufb00usion Models"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      315,
      502,
      331
    ],
    "text": "To not give too much away, I'll brie\ufb02y explain what di\ufb00usion models"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      331,
      115,
      348
    ],
    "text": "are."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      360,
      502,
      376
    ],
    "text": "Di\ufb00usion models are a class of generative models that are trained to"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      376,
      502,
      393
    ],
    "text": "predict the next step of a sequence of data. The idea is to predict the"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      393,
      502,
      409
    ],
    "text": "next  step  of  a  sequence  of  data,  given  the  previous  steps."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      409,
      502,
      426
    ],
    "text": "Architecturally, di\ufb00usion models are based on the idea of denoising"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      426,
      173,
      442
    ],
    "text": "autoencoders."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      454,
      502,
      471
    ],
    "text": "Autoencoders  are  a  class  of  neural  networks  that  are  trained  to"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      471,
      502,
      487
    ],
    "text": "reconstruct their input. They do this by encoding the input into a latent"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      487,
      502,
      504
    ],
    "text": "representation and then decoding this latent representation back into"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      504,
      183,
      520
    ],
    "text": "the input space."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      532,
      502,
      549
    ],
    "text": "The  encoder  and  decoder  are  trained  jointly,  such  that  the"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      549,
      502,
      565
    ],
    "text": "reconstruction error is minimized. Geometrically, we can think of the"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      565,
      502,
      582
    ],
    "text": "endcoder as a mapping from the input space to a lower-dimensional"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      582,
      502,
      598
    ],
    "text": "manifold, and the decoder as a mapping from this manifold back to the"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      598,
      502,
      615
    ],
    "text": "input space. Both do that sequentially using a series of layers. As usual,"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      615,
      502,
      631
    ],
    "text": "the layer dimensions are a power of 2, e.g. 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, etc."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      631,
      322,
      648
    ],
    "text": "This applies to the encoder and decoder."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      660,
      502,
      676
    ],
    "text": "So we shrink the input data into a lower-dimensional space and then"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      676,
      502,
      693
    ],
    "text": "expand it back to the original space. For some reason, this works well"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      693,
      272,
      709
    ],
    "text": "for the task of image denoising."
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      721,
      502,
      738
    ],
    "text": "The input of the di\ufb00usion model is a sequence of data, and the output is"
  },
  {
    "type": "text",
    "bbox": [
      93,
      738,
      502,
      754
    ],
